task.name: open_microwave_door_put_green_duck
task.description: Use the left arm to open the microwave oven door. Then use the right arm to put the green duck inside the microwave oven.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the microwave oven door handle.
2. Grasp the microwave oven door handle with the left arm.
3. Pull the microwave oven door open using the left arm.
4. Move the right arm to approach and align with the green duck.
5. Grasp the green duck with the right arm.
6. Move the right arm to align with the inside of the microwave oven.
7. Release the gripper to place the green duck inside the microwave oven.
